global_edge_id: deterministic parent-to-current edge index in SWC row order; disambiguated by source_model_id and exported in manifests/global_edges.csv
radius_storage: SWC radius_raw_um per global node; interpolated only at exact cuts
previous_roi_definition: connected descendant branch subtree for Figure 1(b)-style visualization
sampling_roi_definition: axis-aligned physical box clipping followed by anchor-containing connected component
spatial_query: cKDTree edge-midpoint query plus exact edge-AABB and segment-box tests
ui_integration: saved candidate/selected manifests and ROI NPZ -> existing PyVista display; no sampling or clustering in callbacks
